authenticity_review: The image demonstrates strong technical execution but contains notable AI artifacts. The giraffe's mouth/snout area exhibits structural collapse where anatomical boundaries melt into fur texture (severity 3). Rabbit fur shows painterly smoothing rather than individual hair strands (severity 2). The giraffe head-neck junction appears anatomically implausible with unnatural angling (severity 2). Despite these issues, lighting coherence and overall composition remain solid. The taxonomy mismatch (hares vs rabbits) affects semantic accuracy but not visual authenticity per se.
